pages.text: {{hero}} has a big dump truck. It is red and black. Honk, honk! {{hero}} and the truck help at the big dig on the hill.
The digger fills the truck with rocks and sand. {{hero}} must bring the stuff to the top of the hill. Then the gang can fix the path.
But the path is thick with mud. Splat! The truck slips and gets stuck. {{hero}} pumps the gas, but the truck just spins.
Then the digger chugs up. It sets flat rocks in the mud. The truck gets a grip. Up, up, up! {{hero}} gets to the top of the hill.
At dusk, {{hero}} rests in bed. But at the top of the hill, the digger dug up a big tin chest. What is in the chest?
